stories.title: Can I Play With You?
stories.zh: 想加入游戏只要勇敢问一句：我能一起玩吗？
sentences: I see kids playing ball.
The ball goes up and down.
They look so happy.
I want to play too.
I take a big breath.
"Can I play with you?"
"Yes! Come and join us!"
Now we play together.
The ball flies to me. I catch it!
Asking is easy. Friends say yes.

stories.title: Sharing My Toys
stories.zh: 分享玩具，快乐翻倍。
sentences: I have a red kite.
I have a brown teddy bear.
I have many toys.
My friend Lily comes over.
She looks at my toys.
"Do you want to play?" I ask.
We fly the kite together.
We make tea for teddy.
Two people, twice the fun!
Sharing makes me happy.

stories.title: Sorry Means a Lot
stories.zh: 不小心弄坏了朋友的积木，一句对不起让友谊回来了。
sentences: Tom and I build with blocks.
We build a tall, tall tower.
I run to get more blocks.
Oh no! My foot hits the table.
The tower falls down. Crash!
Tom's eyes are full of tears.
"I am so sorry," I say.
"It is OK," Tom says slowly.
We build the tower again, together.
A sorry can fix many things.

stories.title: A Friend for Foxy
stories.zh: 小狐狸阿福搬新家找朋友，一次分享让它有了最好的伙伴。
sentences: Foxy the fox moved to a new woods.
"Who will play with me?"
He asked the bird in the tree.
The bird was busy with her eggs.
He asked the rabbit in the grass.
The rabbit was busy with his carrots.
Foxy sat alone under the moon.
Then he heard a little cry.
A small cat was lost in the dark!
Foxy shared his warm tail. They became best friends.

stories.title: The Birthday Gift
stories.zh: 亲手画的画是最棒的生日礼物，心意比价格更重要。
sentences: Tomorrow is Amy's birthday.
What can I give her?
I have no money for a big gift.
But I have paper and crayons!
I draw a big blue bird.
I draw flowers and a sun.
I write, "Happy Birthday, Amy!"
At the party, Amy opens it.
"This is the best gift!" she says.
She hugs me very tight.

stories.title: Helping Hands
stories.zh: 帮妈妈打扫、帮爷爷浇花，帮助别人心里甜甜的。
sentences: Mom is cleaning the house.
"Can I help?" I ask.
"Yes! Please put away your toys."
One toy, two toys, three.
I put the blocks in the box.
Grandpa is watering the flowers.
"Can I help?" I ask.
I water the little red flowers.
They drink and smile at the sun.
Helping hands are happy hands.

stories.title: The New Kid
stories.zh: 新同学第一天有点孤单，一个微笑让她变成了好朋友。
sentences: A new girl came to our class.
She stood quietly by the door.
She did not know anyone.
Her shoes were new and white.
I smiled and waved at her.
She smiled back, just a little.
"Do you want to sit with me?"
We shared my crayons at art time.
Now we play together every day.
One smile can make a friend.

stories.title: Rainy Day Together
stories.zh: 下雨不能出去玩，和朋友在室内盖被子城堡。
sentences: Rain, rain, all day long.
We can not go out to play.
My friend comes to my house.
What can we do inside?
We build a blanket fort!
Two chairs and a big blanket.
We crawl inside with flashlights.
We tell silly stories and laugh.
The rain sings on the window.
Rainy days can be fun too.

stories.title: My Best Friend
stories.zh: 最好的朋友会陪你笑、陪你哭、永远站在你身边。
sentences: My best friend is Tom.
He has curly hair and a big smile.
When I am happy, he laughs with me.
When I fall down, he helps me up.
When I am sad, he sits with me.
We like the same games.
We like the same songs.
Sometimes we fight, but not for long.
Best friends always come back.
I am lucky to have Tom.

stories.title: The Lost Teddy
stories.zh: 妹妹的泰迪熊丢了，全家出动寻找，原来在洗衣机里睡着了。
sentences: My little sister cried and cried.
Her teddy bear was gone!
"Do not cry. We will find him."
We looked under the bed.
We looked behind the door.
We looked in the toy box.
No teddy anywhere!
Then we heard a funny sound.
It came from the washing machine.
Teddy was taking a bath! We all laughed.

stories.title: Mom's Warm Hug
stories.zh: 摔疼了的膝盖，妈妈的抱抱比创可贴还有用。
sentences: I fell off my bike.
My knee hurt a little.
I ran to find Mom.
Mom opened her arms wide.
She gave me a big, warm hug.
The hug was soft like a cloud.
My knee still had a band-aid.
But the hurt flew away!
Mom's hugs are magic.
I love you, Mom.

stories.title: Dad the Super Chef
stories.zh: 爸爸周末下厨，煎蛋像太阳，面条像云朵。
sentences: On Sunday, Dad cooks breakfast.
Dad wears a tall white hat.
"I am a super chef!" he says.
He cracks two eggs. Crack, crack!
The eggs look like little suns.
He cooks long, long noodles.
They look like white clouds.
Everything tastes so good!
Mom says, "Yum! Ten points!"
Dad is the best chef in the world.

stories.title: Grandma's Cookies
stories.zh: 和奶奶一起烤饼干，面粉撒得像下雪。
sentences: Grandma bakes the best cookies.
Today I will help her!
We wash our hands first.
We mix the flour and butter.
Flour falls like white snow!
I make a star cookie.
Grandma makes a moon cookie.
We wait by the warm oven.
Ding! The cookies are ready.
They taste like love.

stories.title: Grandpa's Garden
stories.zh: 爷爷的花园里有向日葵、番茄和小蜗牛。
sentences: Grandpa has a magic garden.
Sunflowers grow tall and yellow.
Red tomatoes hide in green leaves.
I help Grandpa water them.
We find a little snail.
He carries his house on his back!
"Hello, Mr. Snail!"
The bees come to say hi too.
Grandpa's garden is full of life.
I want a garden like this one day.

stories.title: My Baby Brother
stories.zh: 小弟弟会抓我手指咯咯笑，我是最棒的大姐姐。
sentences: I have a baby brother.
He is small and soft.
He can not talk yet.
He speaks in goo-goo sounds!
I hold his tiny hand.
He grabs my finger.
I make a funny face.
He laughs and kicks his feet.
Mom says I am a big sister now.
I will take care of him, always.

stories.title: My Big Sister
stories.zh: 姐姐教我系鞋带，帮我够高处的书。
sentences: I have a big sister.
She is tall and kind.
She teaches me to tie my shoes.
Bunny ears, loop, and pull!
I can not reach my book.
She gets it for me.
When thunder scares me at night,
she holds my hand and sings.
"You are the best sister!"
She smiles and pats my head.

stories.title: Cleanup Day
stories.zh: 全家大扫除，擦桌子扫地，家变得亮晶晶。
sentences: Today is cleanup day!
Dad cleans the windows.
Mom sweeps the floor.
I put my books on the shelf.
Sister folds the clothes.
Even the cat chases the dust!
We work and we laugh.
The house shines like a star.
We sit down for sweet tea.
A clean home is a happy home.

stories.title: The Weekend
stories.zh: 周末不用上学，全家窝在沙发上看书吃水果。
sentences: It is the weekend!
No school today. Hooray!
We stay in our warm home.
Dad reads his thick book.
Mom cuts a sweet watermelon.
Sister draws a purple cat.
I build a block castle.
The cat sleeps in the sun.
We are all together.
This is the best weekend.

stories.title: When I Am Sick
stories.zh: 生病发烧时全家照顾我，很快又活蹦乱跳。
sentences: I do not feel good today.
My head is hot.
Mom touches my forehead.
"You have a fever, sweetie."
I stay in bed under warm blankets.
Dad brings me warm water.
Sister draws me a get-well card.
Mom tells me a quiet story.
The next day, I feel better!
My family took care of me.

stories.title: Hugs for Everyone
stories.zh: 睡前给全家每人一个抱抱，爱要说出来。
sentences: It is time for bed.
But first, hugs for everyone!
A big hug for Dad.
A soft hug for Mom.
A quick hug for my sister.
A gentle hug for the baby.
Even a hug for my teddy bear!
"I love you," I say.
"We love you too," they say.
I fall asleep with a smile.

stories.title: Hello, Sun!
stories.zh: 太阳公公的一天：叫醒公鸡、晒干露水、染红晚霞。
sentences: The sun wakes up in the east.
"Good morning, world!"
He tickles the rooster's tail.
Cock-a-doodle-doo!
He dries the dew on the grass.
He warms my window.
He plays hide-and-seek with clouds.
In the evening, he turns orange.
He paints the sky pink and red.
"Good night! See you tomorrow!"

stories.title: The Rainy Puddle
stories.zh: 雨停了，地上的水洼是孩子的小海洋。
sentences: The rain has stopped.
The sun peeks out.
I put on my yellow rain boots.
I find a big puddle.
It is like a little sea!
The sky is inside the puddle.
I step in. Splash!
Muddy water jumps up.
I splash and splash and splash.
Rain boots and puddles are best friends.

stories.title: The Kite in the Wind
stories.zh: 风筝乘着风越飞越高，风是看不见的好朋友。
sentences: The wind blows today.
It pushes the trees. Swoosh!
It is a good day for a kite.
I hold my red kite tight.
Run, run, run!
The wind lifts my kite.
Up, up, up it goes!
The string pulls my hand.
My kite dances with the wind.
Thank you, wind, my flying friend!

stories.title: Snow Is Falling
stories.zh: 第一场雪落下来，堆雪人打雪仗，冬天真好玩。
sentences: Look out of the window!
White flakes are falling.
Snow! It is snow!
The ground turns white.
The trees turn white.
I put on my warm coat.
I catch snow on my tongue.
We build a fat snowman.
A carrot nose and a red scarf!
Winter is a white, happy world.

stories.title: The Little Seed
stories.zh: 小种子钻进泥土，喝雨水晒太阳，长成了大向日葵。
sentences: I plant a little seed.
I cover it with soft soil.
"Sleep well, little seed."
The rain waters it. Drip, drop.
The sun warms it. So nice.
One morning, a sprout pops up!
"Hello, world!"
It grows taller every day.
At last, it is a big sunflower.
It turns its face to the sun.

stories.title: A Bee's Busy Day
stories.zh: 小蜜蜂拜访花朵采蜜，花儿谢谢它帮忙传粉。
sentences: Buzz, buzz! Here comes a little bee.
She has so much work today.
She flies to the red rose.
"Hello, Bee! Please take my honey."
She flies to the yellow sunflower.
"Hello, Bee! My honey is sweet."
Buzz, buzz, from flower to flower.
Her little bags are full of gold.
"Thank you, Bee!"
"You help us grow. You are welcome!"

stories.title: The Butterfly
stories.zh: 毛毛虫吃了睡睡了吃，结茧破壳变成漂亮蝴蝶。
sentences: A little caterpillar crawls.
She is green and small.
She eats leaves all day.
Crunch, crunch, crunch!
She grows fat and long.
She makes a little house. It is a chrysalis.
She sleeps inside. One, two, ten days.
One morning, the house opens!
Out comes a beautiful butterfly!
She spreads her wings and flies.

stories.title: Where Is the Moon?
stories.zh: 月亮有时圆有时弯，有时躲起来，它一直都在。
sentences: Where is the moon tonight?
Yesterday it was round like a plate.
Today it is thin like a banana.
Tomorrow, where will it go?
Sometimes it hides behind clouds.
I can not see it at all.
But I know it is still there.
Moon, are you playing hide-and-seek?
The stars twinkle and laugh.
Good night, moon, wherever you are.

stories.title: The Rainbow
stories.zh: 雨后太阳出来，天上挂起七彩桥。
sentences: The rain goes away.
The sun comes out to play.
Look up at the sky!
A rainbow is there!
Red and orange and yellow.
Green and blue and purple.
So many colors in one line!
It looks like a magic bridge.
Can I walk on it? Maybe not!
Hello, rainbow. You are so pretty.

stories.title: Autumn Leaves
stories.zh: 秋风把树叶染成黄色红色，落叶铺成软软的地毯。
sentences: Autumn is here.
The wind turns the leaves yellow.
Some turn red. Some turn brown.
The leaves let go of the trees.
They dance in the wind.
Round and round, down they come.
They make a soft carpet on the ground.
I collect the prettiest ones.
Crunch, crunch when I walk!
Goodbye, leaves. See you in spring.

stories.title: The Silly Hat
stories.zh: 爷爷的帽子卡在头上下不来，全家想办法，喷嚏救了场。
sentences: Grandpa tried on my party hat.
It was too small for his big head.
Now the hat was stuck!
"Pull it!" said Mom. They pulled.
"Twist it!" said Dad. They twisted.
The hat did not come off.
Grandpa looked so funny!
We all tried not to laugh.
Then Grandpa's nose felt tickly...
Ah-choo! The hat flew off! We all laughed.

stories.title: Monkey See, Monkey Do
stories.zh: 小猴子学爷爷戴眼镜、学奶奶拄拐杖，学得滑稽又可爱。
sentences: A little monkey watched Grandpa Lion.
Grandpa put on his glasses.
Monkey put leaves on his eyes!
He watched Grandma Bear.
Grandma walked with a stick.
Monkey walked with a branch!
He watched the baby duck.
The duck waddled left and right.
Monkey waddled too. Plop! He fell.
Everyone laughed. Monkey laughed too!

stories.title: The Dog Who Said Moo
stories.zh: 小狗跟牛学 moo 叫，跟羊学 baa，最后还是汪汪最合适。
sentences: A puppy met a big cow.
The cow said, "Moo!"
The puppy said, "Moo!"
The cow laughed. "You are a dog!"
The puppy met a sheep.
The sheep said, "Baa!"
The puppy said, "Baa!"
The sheep laughed. "You are a dog!"
The puppy thought and thought.
"Woof! Woof!" That was perfect!

stories.title: The Mud Cake
stories.zh: 小猪用泥巴做了个大蛋糕送给妈妈，妈妈的反应暖暖的。
sentences: Tomorrow is Mom Pig's birthday.
Little Pig wanted to make a cake.
But he had no flour or eggs.
He had... mud! Lots of mud!
He mixed and patted the mud.
He put flowers on the top.
"Happy birthday, Mom!"
Mom Pig looked at the mud cake.
She hugged Little Pig tight.
"The best cake ever!" she smiled.

stories.title: The Sock Monster
stories.zh: 袜子总丢一只？原来是洗衣机后面住了个爱收集袜子的小家伙。
sentences: Where do my socks go?
I put in two. I get out one!
One sock always runs away.
Mom says, "The sock monster took it!"
One day, I heard a little sound.
It came from behind the washing machine.
I peeked. What did I see?
A tiny monster in a sock hat!
He had ten of my socks!
"Can I have them back?" He gave me nine. Fair enough!

stories.title: Cat on My Head
stories.zh: 小猫总在早晨睡到头上，像一顶会呼噜的帽子。
sentences: Every morning, the same thing!
I wake up with something warm.
It is soft. It is purring.
It is... the cat on my head!
"Good morning," says the cat.
Well, he says, "Meow."
He thinks my head is his bed.
I walk to breakfast. He rides along.
My hair is full of cat fur.
A purring hat is the best hat.

stories.title: The Dancing Duck
stories.zh: 小鸭子一看音乐就摇摆，整个池塘开起了舞会。
sentences: There was a duck who loved music.
When music played, something happened.
His feet went tap, tap, tap!
His tail went shake, shake, shake!
He could not stop dancing!
The fish jumped to the beat.
The frogs hopped in a line.
Even slow turtle moved his head.
The pond turned into a dance party!
Everybody dance, quack, quack!

stories.title: The Yawning Bear
stories.zh: 哈欠会传染！熊一个哈欠传遍整座森林。
sentences: Big Bear sat under a tree.
He felt a yawn coming.
Ah... ah... ah-choo-no, a YAWN!
Next to him, Rabbit yawned.
On the branch, Bird yawned.
In the grass, Duck yawned.
In the river, Fish yawned. Blub!
Everyone in the forest yawned.
Big Bear laughed and said,
"Let us all take a nap!" And they did.

stories.title: The Sneezing Panda
stories.zh: 熊猫一闻到花粉就打大喷嚏，喷嚏的力量大得惊人。
sentences: There was a panda named Po.
Po loved flowers. Oh no!
Flowers made Po sneeze.
Ah... ah... AH-CHOO!
His sneeze blew off his hat.
His sneeze shook the bamboo.
His sneeze woke the sleeping pig!
"Po, no more flowers for you."
But flowers were so pretty.
AH-CHOO! There went his hat again!

stories.title: Bubble Trouble
stories.zh: 泡泡水倒太多，整个教室都是泡泡，像云朵学校。
sentences: It was bubble day at school.
Each kid got a little cup.
But I knocked over the BIG bottle!
Glug, glug, glug! Bubble soap everywhere!
The bubbles began to grow.
One bubble was as big as a ball!
One was as big as a chair!
One was as big as the teacher!
The classroom turned into clouds.
"Best day ever!" we all shouted.

stories.title: The Sleepy Little Cat
stories.zh: 小猫找最舒服的地方睡觉，最后发现妈妈的怀里最好。
sentences: The little cat was sleepy.
She tried to sleep on the chair.
The chair was too hard.
She tried to sleep in the box.
The box was too small.
She tried to sleep by the fire.
The fire spot was too hot.
Then Mother Cat called softly.
The little cat snuggled in Mom's arms.
Warm, soft, perfect. Zzz...

stories.title: Good Night, Farm
stories.zh: 跟农场每个朋友道晚安，大家都睡了。
sentences: The sun sets behind the farm.
Good night, big cow. Moo... zzz.
Good night, little pig. Oink... zzz.
Good night, red hen. Cluck... zzz.
Good night, white sheep. Baa... zzz.
Good night, brown horse. Neigh... zzz.
Good night, little duck. Quack... zzz.
The barn is quiet now.
The stars watch over the farm.
Good night, farm. Sleep tight.

stories.title: The Moon Boat
stories.zh: 弯弯的月亮像小船，载着孩子飘过星空。
sentences: The moon is like a little boat.
Tonight, it floats by my window.
"Hop in," says the moon boat.
I climb in, soft as a dream.
We float over the sleeping town.
We float over the quiet sea.
Stars swim by like little fish.
The wind sings a low, slow song.
My eyes are heavy now.
The moon boat rocks me to sleep.

stories.title: Little Star's Bed
stories.zh: 小星星找自己的云朵床，找到了才安心眨眼睡觉。
sentences: High in the sky, a little star yawned.
"Where is my bed tonight?"
He looked at the round moon.
The moon was full. No room!
He looked at the fluffy clouds.
That cloud was too thin.
That cloud was too gray.
Then he found the softest cloud.
It was white like cotton candy.
He snuggled in. Twinkle... twinkle... zzz.

stories.title: The Dream Blanket
stories.zh: 盖上奶奶织的小毯子，就会做甜甜的梦。
sentences: Grandma knitted me a little blanket.
It is blue like the night sky.
Grandma said it was magic.
"It brings sweet dreams."
Tonight I sleep under it.
I dream of flying over clouds.
I dream of a candy mountain.
I dream of laughing with friends.
In the morning, I remember them all.
Thank you, magic dream blanket.

stories.title: Night-Night, Bear
stories.zh: 小熊害怕黑，月亮和萤火虫点亮了它的夜晚。
sentences: Little Bear did not like the dark.
"It is too black at night!"
The moon heard him.
She shone her light through the window.
"Now it is silver," said Little Bear.
A firefly flew in.
His little light blinked. Blink, blink!
Another firefly came. Then ten!
The room was full of tiny stars.
"The dark can be beautiful," smiled Little Bear. "Night-night."

stories.title: The Quiet Owl
stories.zh: 猫头鹰守着夜晚，看顾所有睡着的小动物。
sentences: When everyone sleeps, owl wakes up.
Whooo is watching the night?
The quiet owl, that is who.
She watches the sleeping bunnies.
She watches the dreaming ducks.
She watches the snoring bear.
If a little one cries, she calls Mom.
Whooo... whooo... all is well.
The night is safe and soft.
Sleep on, little ones. Owl is here.

stories.title: Sleep, Little Fish
stories.zh: 海里的朋友也有睡前仪式：泡泡晚安吻。
sentences: The sea turns dark blue.
The sun goes down, down, down.
"Time for bed," says Mother Fish.
The little fish yawns. Blub!
The whale sings a low, deep song.
The seahorse rocks in the grass.
The starfish tucks in the sand.
The little fish blows a good-night kiss.
A bubble floats up. Pop!
Sleep, little fish, under the quiet sea.

stories.title: One More Kiss
stories.zh: 睡前讨价还价：再亲一个、再抱一下，最后安心睡着。
sentences: "Time to sleep," says Mom.
"One more kiss?" I ask.
Mom kisses my forehead.
"One more hug?" I ask.
Mom hugs me, warm and tight.
"One more blanket?" I ask.
Mom tucks the blanket in.
"One more... " I start to say.
But my eyes are closing...
Zzz. Mom smiles: "Good night, my love."

stories.title: Sweet Dreams, Little One
stories.zh: 世界跟孩子一起入睡：太阳睡了花儿睡了，你也睡吧。
sentences: The sun has gone to sleep.
The flowers have closed their eyes.
The birds are in their nests.
The fish are in their coral beds.
The moon is on watch.
The stars keep her company.
Your bed is warm and soft.
Your teddy is by your side.
Close your eyes, little one.
Sweet dreams. I love you.
